### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **10** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, `@objectstack/service-settings`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **77** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/platform-admin-gate.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**43** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/platform-admin-gate.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 41 pages)`
- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **157** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6879ae4c29bfc06ca41bbdaae7648a1ff65a28d7` — the merge of head `5b59be6e66d7b2419c754ee756ee82dd30d1f1d2` into base `b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6879ae4c29bfc06ca41bbdaae7648a1ff65a28d7 && git checkout 6879ae4c29bfc06ca41bbdaae7648a1ff65a28d7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4 5b59be6e66d7b2419c754ee756ee82dd30d1f1d2 && git checkout -B drift-repro b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4 && git merge --no-ff 5b59be6e66d7b2419c754ee756ee82dd30d1f1d2

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b60eb78d35044949839e383823b228bcaf67dec4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** API key 现在和它主人的登录会话给出同一个答案。主人被「强制两步验证」扣住(宽限期满仍未绑定)时,这把 key 在所有接口上都返回同样的 403 MFA_REQUIRED;主人一绑定就立即恢复,不用重新签发。主人只是密码过期,或被管理员强制改密时,key 照常工作。管理员强制改密改用自己的码 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED,并带一个「退出所有会话并吊销 API key」开关:默认开(你选的 A),管理员可以显式关掉,被吊销的 key 也可以用「Restore API Key」恢复。
- **为什么改:** 裁决 C′:扣账号的姿态扣住这个账号的每一种凭证,扣密码的姿态只扣密码登录。同一个请求(key 加会话 cookie)在不同接口上不能有两个答案。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 开了强制两步验证的部署里,没绑定的员工手里的 key 在宽限期满后会被拒,直到本人绑定。管理员重置密码默认会让该用户在所有设备上退出、key 被吊销(可逐个恢复)。Console 还不认识新码,所以要等 objectstack-ai/objectui#12365 进了 `.objectui-sha` 才落地,否则被强制改密的用户会卡在裸 403 上。另有两处接缝(cloud-connection 本地安装、MCP stdio)本 PR 没覆盖,已立 #23455、#23456,本 PR 落地后由本席接上。回滚:回退本 PR 即恢复旧行为。
- **席位意见:** 建议批准。本 PR 改了 61 个文件、2882 行(低于 3000 行门槛),只因为 3 个 `skills/**` 自动生成的索引行碰到受管面,才需要你批准。七个接口各有正反对照的 pin,消融实验只让被扣的用例变红。席位复核为 ACCEPT(下方);在档契约复审在新 head 上进行。
- **你要做的:** 用 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 在本 PR 上提交一次 Approve。批准之后,本席等三件事到齐再落地:契约复审 PASS、objectui#12365 进 pin、CI 在落地 head 上全绿。

## 席位核对

`domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm` · claim `6165524186` on #23287 · reviewed head `5b59be6e66d7b2419c754ee756ee82dd30d1f1d2` · 2026-10-14T11:40Z (first verdict REWORK on `56004af60cb3de3f5de9509abe6989ac9cb9ad95`, edited in place)

**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Tier H: it lands only on an authorized approval, with the landing clauses in item 7.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #23287`; no other closing keyword sits beside any card number in the body (scanned). `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` at line start in the body and in the changeset. 61 files, +2678 / −204 = 2882 changed lines against `main`. `check-governed-merges --pr 23440`: governed, Tier H, on the three `skills/**` `gen:skill-refs` outputs (the generated-surface exception did not lift them).
2. **Premises measured against ruling C′ (`6159450584`), read on the diff.**
   - Item 1: `AuthGateCodeSchema` is closed (`PASSWORD_EXPIRED`, `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`, `MFA_REQUIRED`). `AUTH_GATE_SCOPES` is total over it: `MFA_REQUIRED` → `account`, both password codes → `credential`. `authGate.code` is typed against it.
   - Item 2: `must_change_password` answers `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`, and `revokeSessionsAndKeys` defaults ON (the maintainer's letter A, `6165848580`).
   - Item 3: one judgment, in `resolveApiKeyAdmission` (the `held` outcome, after the tenancy refusal, in the key's own organization). `resolveAuthzContext` resolves a held key as a held principal and never falls through to the session. REST `computeExecCtx` and `HttpDispatcher.enforceAuthGate` re-read the cookie only for `credential: 'session'`.
   - Item 4: nothing is written on a hold, and the pins show the same key served again once the posture clears.
   - The dev's three disproved or partial premises are accepted as reported.
3. **Gates.**
   - On `56004af60` (the reviewed code): 36 success, 7 skipped, 0 failures. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (six shards), `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Check Changeset` all succeeded.
   - On the patch head `5b59be6e6`, CI is converging (no failure at this edit).
   - Rejection pins assert `status`, `error.code` and `message`.
4. **REWORK item, closed.** The changeset sentence on revoked keys now names the `restore_api_key` action (commit `5b59be6e66`, one line). The patch round's base merge (`37d650fb32`, `origin/main` `4e0838d997`) regenerated nothing; its only PR-owned overlap is a doc-comment hunk in `execution-context.zod.ts`, auto-merged.
5. **Accepted deviations.** The file surface grew producer-side as the dispatch allowed: `runtime` `dispatcher-plugin.ts` and `resolve-execution-context.ts`, `platform-objects` (action param and four bundles), `plugin-auth` `forced-reset-revocation.ts` and `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, stale two-code comments at the doors, regenerated references. The patch round took the role file's base merge.
6. **Out-of-scope dispositions.**
   - Filed: #23455 (the cloud-connection install-local resolver), #23456 (MCP stdio), objectstack-ai/objectui#12365 (the Console's `detectAuthGate`).
   - Acceptance notes: the declared-endpoint fallback's session-only floor (`carrier:` none).
   - Seat observation, carried to the dispatch of #23455 and #23456: `userAuthGates` is optional, so an unwired caller fails open by omission. Once the last two seams are wired, making it required closes the class.
   - Patch round: `forced-reset-revocation.ts`'s docblock still says the owner mints a replacement, and the Set Password helpText and `authentication.mdx` are silent on restore. All three are accurate or comment-only, so they are dropped and not filed.
7. **Landing clauses.**
   - (a) A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` `## Contract review` PASS on the landing head.
   - (b) Tier H: an authorized APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` or `hotlong`.
   - (c) objectstack's `.objectui-sha` on `main` carries objectstack-ai/objectui#12365's fix (REST `compare` against the pin), per the landing order on #23287 (`6165848580`).
   - (d) Every check green on the landing head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5b59be6e66d7b2419c754ee756ee82dd30d1f1d2`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #23287 (body and all 15 comments, ruling C′ `6159450584` and the letter A record `6165848580` included), PR #23440 (body, 61-file list, the diff against the merge base `4e0838d997`, +2678 / −204; the base merge `37d650fb32` brought no PR-owned change beyond one doc-comment hunk), and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, run, re-run or ablated.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Closed posture vocabulary and its scope (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`) — right.** `AuthGateCodeSchema` is the closed enum `PASSWORD_EXPIRED | PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED | MFA_REQUIRED`; `AuthGateScopeSchema` is `account | credential`; `AUTH_GATE_SCOPES` is a frozen `Readonly Record` typed total over the enum (`MFA_REQUIRED` account, the two password codes credential), so an undeclared scope does not compile. `ExecutionContext.authGate.code` narrows from `z.string()` to the enum: a published accept-set narrowing, server-constructed and never authored, with one in-tree producer. The api-surface, declaration-map, export-origins and json-schema manifest shards, the reference docs (1533 to 1535 schemas) and the ADR-0122 isomorphic pin count (785 to 787) move in the same diff. Ruling items 1 and 2 as written.
2. **`PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` under `@objectstack/plugin-auth` — right.** `must_change_password` stops reusing `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` (the import-users and set-user-password paths both now answer the new code); the generated contract and ledger pages carry it. The wire code for an administrator-forced change changes, which is breaking for a client keyed on `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`; the Console half is objectui#12365.
3. **`IAuthService.resolveUserAuthGates?(userId, { organizationId? })` — right.** An optional contract member keyed by user id, answering every held posture most-urgent-first (forced reset, expiry, MFA), `[]` when no policy is enabled (no read) or on a lookup error (fail-open, as the session gate). `AuthManager.resolveUserAuthGates` is the one implementation; `computeAuthGate` takes its first entry, so a session sees what it saw before. The real composition registers the `AuthManager` instance itself as the `auth` service, so `userAuthGateSourceOf` binds in production and not only in the pins. Keyed by user id, which is the shape #23335's leg asked for.
4. **The `@objectstack/core` additions and the `held` outcome — right, with one named fail-open.** `authGateScope`, `accountScopeAuthGate`, `userAuthGateSourceOf` and the `UserAuthGateSource` type are exported; `resolveApiKeyAdmission` takes an optional posture source and returns `held` (principal plus gate) when the owner holds an account-scope posture, asked after the tenancy refusal and in the key's own organization; a rejecting computation raises `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` (503), never an admission; nothing is written, so the refusal is not a revocation (ruling item 4). `resolveAuthzContext` resolves a held key as a held principal (`credential: 'api_key'`, `authGate` set) and never falls through to the session; the session arm now carries `credential: 'session'` and its own posture, so every door reads one field. `normalizeAuthGate` now answers null for a code outside the vocabulary: a fail-open that only a producer bypassing the typed declaration can reach, and the envelope schema refuses such a code anyway; named here, judged consistent with the closed-enum ruling. `resolveApiKeyPrincipal` is unchanged and cannot be wired; see ③.
5. **The API-key door at the seven faces — right.** REST: `computeExecCtx` hands the source to the resolver and takes a key-admitted principal's posture from the key's answer. Dispatcher: `resolveExecutionContext` hands the source and reports the admitting credential through `onAdmission`; `enforceAuthGate` judges a key-admitted principal with `evaluateAuthGate` (allow-list included) and the declared-endpoint fallback reads the same `admission` off the same protocol context. Datasource admin: `requireDatasourceAdmin` hands the source and judges the resolved context. Share links and settings: each plugin's resolver hands the source and the resolver's posture rides the context the door refuses on. Storage: the door's gate reader asks `resolveApiKeyAdmission` with the door's tenancy posture (`held` refuses, `admitted` and `refused` read no session, `none` falls to the session), and every ledger route is mounted behind that door, so the download authorizer's own unwired resolver call sits behind it. Webhook redeliver: admits no key on either face, pinned as 401. Each face carries its negative control (credential-scope served, cleared posture served again), and the recorded ablation of the `held` arm reddened only the held cases.
6. **Cookie re-read dropped for key-admitted requests — right.** REST, the dispatcher and the declared-endpoint fallback re-read the session for the gate only when a session admitted the caller; the held-session controls on all three still refuse through the re-read.
7. **The forced-reset `revokeSessionsAndKeys` switch — right, one omission.** Default ON for every forced reset (letter A, the maintainer's word on `6165848580`); only a literal `false` turns it off; it runs after the password write; it stamps every live `sys_session` row with the ADR-0069 D4 shape (`expires_at` past, `revoked_at`, `revoke_reason` `admin_password_reset`) and sets `sys_api_key.revoked` on every unrevoked key of the user, system context, a 500-row scan ceiling; the response and the audit row carry counts only, an incomplete revocation is reported and logged and the reset still lands. The `set_user_password` action gains the param with its four translation bundles. Omission: `admin_password_reset` is a new value of `sys_session.revoke_reason`, whose description is, by the field's own comment, the published vocabulary and the only contract a consumer can read; the diff does not add it there. Prose-level, in ③.
8. **The `skills/**` lines — right.** Three one-line regenerations of the export-list fallback in `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-references.ts`, forced by `check:skill-refs`, generator-owned. `skills/**` is a Tier H row of the governed register, so the landing is the authorized approval's clause (recorded on the card, `6167553667`, for this head), not this record's.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset grades `minor` on ten packages: spec, core, rest, runtime, plugin-auth, plugin-sharing, service-datasource, service-settings, service-storage, platform-objects. That is exactly the set of published packages whose source moves; plugin-webhooks gains only a pin and is rightly absent. Under the launch-window convention a breaking change ships as `minor`, and all three breaking carriers are present and agree: the `**BREAKING**` banner, the `feat(spec,core,plugin-auth)!:` summary, and the `narrowing` arm.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` — right, and the one legal reading of both facts (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`: value yes, arm narrowing). Widening: the closed vocabulary and scope table, the new error code, the optional contract member, the new core exports and the `held` arm, the optional `userAuthGates` and `onAdmission` inputs, `HttpProtocolContext.admission`. Narrowing: a held owner's key refused where it was served; `authGate.code` from string to enum; a changed wire code for the forced reset; exhaustive switches over `ApiKeyAdmission['outcome']` must take `held`. The level axis is met: every moved package is at least `minor`.
- ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — right. No authorable spec key, stored shape or metadata surface is renamed or removed; `authGate.code` is server-constructed; the body carries no rewrite prescription, so the exemption's own refusal rule does not bite.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6165340573`:
- Open question 1, landing order with objectui: answered by the seat (letter A on `6165848580`; objectui#12365 filed; the landing waits on `.objectui-sha` carrying it). A sequencing clause, not a contract item of this diff.
- Open question 2, the revocation default with no reason recorded: ruled by the maintainer (letter A, verbatim on `6165848580`), built as ruled. The seat's own cost correction (`6165921805`, a revoked key is restorable through the `restore_api_key` action) is reflected in the changeset at this head.
- Open question 3, the Clause-② grammar: answered by the one reader; see ②.
- Out-of-scope findings: the cloud-connection install-local resolver is #23455; the MCP stdio context is #23456; the Console's two-code `detectAuthGate` is objectui#12365; the declared-endpoint fallback's session-only floor is pre-existing and stays in the acceptance notes (agreed, carrier none).
- Deviations (four families needed producer-side changes; the vocabulary was not closed on main; the file surface beyond the claim; the draft opened before the final gate pass; model-free trailers): each is explained in the PR body and matches the diff; none moves a contract reading.

Patch-round report `6167457099`: no open questions. Its two findings are agreed: the `forced-reset-revocation.ts` docblock still ends "the owner mints a replacement" while the changeset now says a routine reset's key can be restored, and the helpText and docs are silent on restore — prose only, the seat's to fold or leave; `main` moved after the merge with no overlap, so no re-merge is owed.

Security, key-admitting surfaces the diff leaves unasked and nothing has filed:
- (a) `resolveApiKeyPrincipal` in `packages/core/src/security/api-key.ts`, exported by core and re-exported by runtime: it calls the seam with no posture input and collapses the verdict to a principal, so any host that admits keys through it admits a held owner's key. The ruling named it as one of the seam's two callers; no door in this tree calls it today, and the changeset's "pass `userAuthGates`" sentence does not reach it because it has no such input. Escalated to the seat: file it (wire an optional source through it, or retire it), function level. Not a seam this tree serves, so not a FAIL input.
- (b) The `sys_session.revoke_reason` published vocabulary line (item 7 above) lacks `admin_password_reset`. Escalated to the seat: fold the one-line description edit into the PR or file it with the landing.
- (c) The `normalizeAuthGate` fail-open on an out-of-vocabulary code (item 4): named, no filing owed under the closed-enum ruling.
- Not gaps: the storage download authorizer's unwired resolver call sits behind the family door; the plugin-sharing exec-context testkit and the dogfood harness are not request seams.

Governed landing: three `skills/**` generated lines make the PR Tier H; the authorized approval for this head is recorded on the card. Tier S does not apply.

Check-runs on `5b59be6e66`, read 2026-10-14T11:57Z: 48 runs — 37 success, 10 skipped, 1 in_progress (Test Core 4/6), 0 failure. The in_progress is recorded as such; the landing clause that every check be green is the seat's.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23287-key-posture-scope`
Reviewed-by: `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm`

**VERDICT: PASS**
